title: Create construction reference cards as declared principal-axis Image Empties

reference_issue: construction card imported from free perspective view
image empty tilted away from principal axis
single image duplicated and mislabeled as distinct multi-view evidence

preconditions: the selected image is authorized for a named construction property or view
the intended view is FRONT, RIGHT, or TOP rather than an arbitrary free-view trace
same-target and same-variant evidence has been established separately when multiple views are used
required_observations: Image Empty type and loaded source path
declared view axis and world-space card normal
whether each construction axis has a genuinely distinct source image
photographic perspective, crop, scale, and same-variant uncertainty outside Blender scene state
action_policy: Create the construction card only after declaring FRONT, RIGHT, or TOP authority, and align its Image Empty normal to that principal axis.
Keep construction cards in a dedicated collection with source path, view role, and calibration intent recorded.
Use distinct same-target images for distinct construction views; rotating a duplicate can aid spatial orientation but does not create new visual evidence.
Keep broad inspiration, material, and contextual references outside the calibrated construction-card claim.
Audit the saved card normals and source-role records before using them to constrain a blockout.
expected_effects: zero principal-axis angular error for declared FRONT, RIGHT, or TOP cards
an editable reference setup that survives saving and fresh-process inspection
clear separation between construction evidence and broader reference-board material
failure_predicates: a construction Image Empty has CUSTOM or undeclared alignment
the measured card normal differs from its declared principal axis beyond tolerance
the same image path is presented as distinct front and side evidence
the underlying photograph's projection or variant identity is unknown but treated as calibrated
recovery: return to the intended orthographic view and recreate or realign the construction card
replace a duplicated single-image view with genuine same-target evidence
downgrade an uncertain photograph to contextual reference instead of construction authority
record unresolved projection or scale uncertainty before blockout

sources.description: Independent browser frames and sampled visible captions verify the perspective-import failure and orthographic re-import correction within 24–124 seconds.

experiments.limitations: Project-owned diagram cards test Blender scene setup only. They do not prove photographic orthography, same-target identity, calibration, or improved model likeness.

version_scope: Public lesson demonstrates an older Blender UI; typed reproduction and transfer verified in Blender 5.2.0 LTS
status_note: The source episode is independently verified and the principal-axis setup passes a fresh-process failure-control and two-view transfer. Runtime use on a human-authorized real prop remains open.
